proposed_title: 11 Yanayer 1944: l-watiqa li bdlat mizane l-isti3mar, machi bidaya wahida dyal l-istiqlal
what_happened: Feature tarikhiyya katrje3 l-Watiqat al-Istiqlal dyal 11 Yanayer 1944 l-siyaq dyalha: nashat l-haraka l-wataniya f-zonat l-himaya, ta2tir l-harb l-3alamiya t-taniya w-Liqa Anfa, w-tahawwol men talab l-islahat l-talab sari7 dyal istiqlal ta7t malikiyya dostoriyya. L-feature khas-ha tbayyen belli had l-watiqa kanat mar7ala mohimma, walakin ma-kantch la awwal mo9awama la sawt jami3 l-Mgharba.
key_facts: Nass l-watiqa mou2arrakh b-11 Yanayer 1944 talab istiqlal l-Mghreb, wa7dat trab, w-nidam siyassi shorawi kay7fed siada dyal s-soltan; source record: Institut Royal pour la Recherche sur l'Histoire du Maroc, Documents du Maroc, accessed 2026-09-02, primary historical/documentary portal, https://www.irmh.ma/

L-3arida t9addmat f-siyaq Protectorat faransi li bda b-Mo3ahadat Fas f-30 Mars 1912; source record: French diplomatic archive, Traite de Fes, 1912-03-30, accessed 2026-09-02, primary treaty/archive, https://basedoc.diplomatie.gouv.fr/

L-haraka l-wataniya ma-bdatch f-1944: mo3aradat Dahir 1930, shabakat s-sa7afa w-l-jam3iyat, w-l-mo9awama l-mosalla7a qbel menha kayfardo qira2a twila; source record: Encyclopaedia Britannica, Morocco - Decline of traditional government / French protectorate, continuously updated, accessed 2026-09-02, independent reference, https://www.britannica.com/place/Morocco/Decline-of-traditional-government-1830-1912

Istiqlal r-rasmi ja f-1956 ba3d azmat nafy Mohammed V f-1953, mo9awama, w-mofawadat; l-watiqa hiya turning point siyasi ma-shi istiqlal f-nafs nhar; source record: US Library of Congress Country Studies, Morocco - The French Zone, 1988, accessed 2026-09-02, independent scholarly synthesis, https://countrystudies.us/morocco/18.htm

contradictory_evidence: Riwaga wataniya sha2i3a kat9addem 11 Yanayer b7al ila hiya bidayat l-kifah kamel; l-adilla 3la mo9awamat Rif, l-Atlas, w-mobilisation qbel 1944 katna9ed had t-tabsit.

Tarkiz 3la l-mow9i3in w-l-madoun l-kobra y9dar ykhfi mosahamat nssa, l-3omal, l-badiya, l-mo9awama l-mosalla7a, w-ikhtilaf tajribat zonat Faransa w-Sbanya; khas had l-ghiyab ytsemma, ma yt3ammarsh b-asma2 bla sanad.
Ba3d l-moraji3 kat3ti 58 w-ba3dha 66 mow9i3; ma khasnach nthbto ra9m wa7ed 7tta n9ablo nuskha archival m3a ta3rif wach kat7seb l-asami l-mol7a9a.
uncertainty: Nass l-feature y9dar y2akked talab l-istiqlal w-siyaq 1912-1956. 3adad l-mow9i3in, tafasil kol wa7ed, w-da3wa belli watiqa wa7dha sbabat l-istiqlal khas-ha verification archival; l-ikhtilaf f-tadakkor ma khasch yt7awwel l-ya9in.
context: Ba3d farḍ l-Protectorat f-1912, l-siyada tqssmat bin s-solta l-isti3mariya w-l-Makhzen, m3a zona sbaniyya f-shmal. Sanawat 1930 shafat ihtijaj 3la Dahir w-tanmiyat sa7afa w-tandim siyasi. L-harb l-3alamiya d3fat Faransa, l-Atlantic Charter nashrat loghat ta9rir l-masir, w-Liqa Anfa 1943 zed f-tawa9o3at—walakin ma kaynach dalil belli l-7olafa wa3do b-istiqlal fouri. Watiqat 1944 jama3at talab sari7; radd l-Protectorat kan 9am3, w-masar 7tta 1956 b9a fih s-soltan, l-a7zab, l-mo9awama, s-siya9 d-dawli, w-tana9odat binhom.
why_it_matters: F-70 3am 3la istiqlal 1956, had l-qira2a katfsel bin t-takhlid w-tarikh: kat3raf 9imat l-watiqa bla ma tms7 l-mar7alat li qblha aw l-aswat li ma dkhloch f-liste rasmiya. Kat3awn l-9ari ychof kifach d-dakira r-rasmiya katbni l-mowatana w-shkon kayb9a barra menha.
strategic_angle: Bni feature 3la tlata: chno talab nass l-watiqa; 3lach 1944 kan moment momkin; w-fin katw9ef riwayat l-botola l-wa7ida. Qaren document, scholarly synthesis, w-l-ghiyabat. Matdirch chronology khawya, w-ma tnsbch istiqlal l-fa3il wa7ed.
